title: Valid Parentheses

examples.explanation: The closing parenthesis appears before the square bracket has closed, so the nesting is invalid.

inputFormat: Implement isValid(s), where s is a string containing only bracket characters.
outputFormat: A boolean: true if all brackets match in the correct nested order, otherwise false.

visuals.title: Matching brackets must nest

visuals.caption: Each closing bracket must match the most recent opening bracket that is still unmatched.
